title: Saturday Raku Workshop with Kevin Russell
bring: bisque-fired pieces from pre-workshop day or brought separately
summary: One-day raku workshop with local expert Kevin Russell on November 21, 2026, for all experience levels. Workshop includes raku glazing techniques; participants create pieces at a pre-workshop session on November 18 and fire them on the main day.
source_quote: Saturday Raku Workshop at The Kiln Studio - Nov 21, 2026... Saturday Nov 21, 2026 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM CST
evidence_sentence: The workshop description states participants will be instructed on raku glazing techniques and application, with raku glazes and all firing equipment provided.
evidence_quote: Join us for a one day Raku Workshop with local expert Kevin Russell! Participants will be instructed on proper Raku glazing techniques and application, and provided with Raku glazes.
